## Checklist

- [ ] PR title uses a Conventional Commit type (for example, `feat(plugin): ...`).
- [ ] No private media or recordings are committed (hard rule 1).
- [ ] Engine and tool versions are pinned (hard rule 3).
- [ ] Remotion and HyperFrames have no cross-engine imports (hard rule 4).
- [ ] Windows process spawning uses Node with npm's `npx-cli.js`, argument arrays, and no shell (hard rule 5).
- [ ] Generated templates use neutral branding from `brand.config.ts` (hard rule 6).
- [ ] Relevant tests were added or updated and run.
- [ ] Any Windows, macOS, or other CI-only verification still pending is noted below.
